notes: The production IosAuthenticatedHostRouter mounts the real shared Profile/SOS surface; the test does not substitute an inert route controller for the edited content.

The Search and Message inputs each own their keyboard session explicitly. Search preserves its exact draft and focus across both rotations without transferring focus to Message; Message then preserves its exact draft and focus across the same transitions.

Post-rotation XCTest assertions never tap either input. The focused Message input stays above the keyboard, and the production opaque UIWindow backdrop contains the complete keyboard bounds in every observed phase.

The backdrop intentionally exceeds the accessibility keyboard frame in landscape to cover the side regions behind the inset keyboard. Equality of those rectangles was a false test assumption; containment is the product invariant demonstrated by the retained screenshots.
